mapper.select: select (case when emp.job=1 then '班主任' when emp.job=2 then '讲师' when emp.job=3 then '学工主管' when emp.job=4 then '教研主管' when emp.job=5 then '咨询师' else '其他' end )pos, count(*) num from emp group by job order by num
select if(emp.gender = 1,'男性职工','女性职工')name, count(*) value from emp group by gender
